pages.title: Fluid Auto-Dictionary
pages.text: This tank turns fluids into others of the same kind, such as one mod's liquid experience into another's. Right-click it to pick the fluid it makes. Pipe a fluid of the same kind into it and it pushes the made fluid out into any neighbour that takes it.

Each fluid has a ratio: 200 of Mariculture experience is worth 200 of Ender IO's experience juice, while 2000 water is just water. The kinds and ratios are in the config, factory.fluid_dictionary; fluids from mods that are not installed are skipped.
